summary: Backend regression passed all six API tests. Public survey submission, dashboard KPIs/filter, QR page, and mobile layout passed. Responses and Settings admin routes are blocked by a reproducible React runtime crash.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout after five failed attempts, although the auth playbook requires it.

minor.issue: JWT is returned in JSON and stored by the frontend in localStorage even though an httpOnly cookie is also set, weakening the intended cookie-based session security.
The field named ip_hash stores the raw request IP, not a hash, which conflicts with the anonymous/privacy intent.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to Data Survey crashes the app with `destroy is not a function`; response search, filter, pagination, detail, and export UI cannot be reached through normal navigation.
Opening Pengaturan Survey reproduces the same `destroy is not a function` React runtime error; settings edit and active/inactive toggle are blocked.

action_items: Fix Responses and Settings useEffect callbacks so they do not return axios promises as React cleanup functions; rerun all admin navigation tests.
Implement server-side login failure tracking and lockout after five failed attempts.
Use a real one-way IP hash or avoid retaining IP data, and remove the JWT from localStorage/JSON if cookie-only auth is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: In App.js, `useEffect(load, [page, rating])` passes a function returning the axios promise; React treats that promise as cleanup and throws during route lifecycle.
In App.js, SettingsPage's `useEffect(() => api.get(...).then(...), [])` also returns a promise and is unsafe as an effect cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 65% (public flow, dashboard, QR, and mobile passed; Responses and Settings blocked)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; existing seeded demo responses were used. One anonymous response was created during the public UI submission test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API suite is green. Reproduce admin crash by logging in, clicking Data Survey or Pengaturan Survey, then verify response table/search/detail/export and settings save/toggle after the useEffect fix. QR and mobile survey already pass.
rca of the issue: Responses uses `useEffect(load, [page, rating])`, where load returns api.get(...).then(...); SettingsPage similarly returns api.get(...).then(...) from useEffect. React interprets the returned Promise as an unmount cleanup and later calls it as destroy, producing `destroy is not a function`.
